payload.reason: The evidence provides a rationale for using ESE methods on user-generated text by highlighting the unique characteristics of such text and the need for better benchmarks and evaluation metrics.

claims.text: User-generated text has distinctive characteristics that differ from well-formed text, making it important for studying ESE methods.
Existing benchmarks for ESE methods are limited to well-formed text, necessitating the development of new benchmarks for user-generated text.
The strong performance of ESE methods does not generalize well to user-generated text, indicating a need for further investigation.
